spec.name: Paintball Open Face Helmet
spec.description: Hollow athletic helmet with tint-ready white team panels, charcoal edging, four open crown vents, a short swept brow, compact ear guards and twin rear fins. Fits around the specified virtual player head without covering the eyes, nose or mouth. Front faces negative Z.

prompt: A cool sporty open-face paintball competition helmet for a Minecraft player, worn as a 3D head item. Monochrome white/light-grey team panels with dark charcoal edge trim, crown vents, swept short brow, compact ear protectors, two small rear fins. Face is completely OPEN: no visor glass, no goggles, no mask, no face plate, no chin strap across face, no geometry in front of eyes nose mouth. Hollow inside: never include a solid head or face. Build around a virtual player head occupying x=4..12, y=4..12, z=4..12; front faces NEGATIVE Z. Keep the entire front opening x=4..12 y=4..11 at z<=4 clear; helmet crown above y=12, sides outside x=4..12, back beyond z=12. Thin shells roughly 1 model unit, attractive streamlined athletic silhouette. White panels will receive orange or blue tint in export; all artwork must be grayscale. Texture the actual helmet parts, do not draw a face. Center wearable shell around x=8,y=8,z=8. Inventory item must look like the same hollow helmet.
